description: A row of profile links. Cook writes a plain list of links inside it at build time; the element supplies the icons, variants and spacing. An empty element takes no space.

attributes.name: services
attributes.description: Comma-separated service ids to show (bluesky, mastodon, github, linkedin, youtube, link); default all visible accounts. Read by Cook at build time.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Icon only (label visually hidden but still the name), label only, or both

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Brand colours on the icons only (label text stays --color-text)

childAttributes.name: data-service
childAttributes.description: Service id that selects the icon: bluesky, mastodon, github, linkedin, youtube or link.

a11y.announces: Nothing; each link is named by its label text
